battle.name: 歌德戰爭
battle.brief: 停發年貢後，哥特聯軍自249年席捲多瑙河防線：奧斯特羅托塔渡河攻入摩西亞、圍困馬爾齊亞諾波利斯，克尼瓦再奪菲利波波利斯。德西烏斯馳援卻在阿布里圖斯沼地戰役中陣亡，帝國野戰軍崩解；253年艾米利安努斯擊退再度越河的新入侵，斯巴達長矛代表的長矛傳統此時僅存於邊軍與拜占庭長矛兵。

kit.name: 斯巴達長矛
kit.history: 兩米長的木槍，槍尾帶銅套。方陣裡它比劍更早決定誰站得住。

countries: 這場戰爭是三世紀危機中羅馬帝國與多瑙河北岸哥特聯軍之間的一場邊境戰爭，交戰區在巴爾幹半島的下多瑙河與色雷斯一帶。羅馬一方的骨架是元老院與禁衛軍，軍事實力則來自駐紮摩西亞上、下兩行省與潘諾尼亞的帝國軍團、由各行省徵召的邊軍，以及受雇於帝國的異族輔助部隊；最高指揮權在皇帝手中，249 年由菲利普斯·阿拉伯人掌握，同年春天落到剛被自己部隊推上位的德西烏斯，251 年再轉到由殘存多瑙河軍團推立的特雷博尼安努斯·加盧斯，253 年的實際戰線指揮則交給摩西亞與潘諾尼亞總督艾米利安努斯。哥特一方並非單一部族，而是以東哥特王奧斯特羅托塔為首、阿爾格多與貢德里科各領一部的聯軍，盟眾包括陶伊法爾人、巴斯塔爾奈人、哈斯丁吉人與卡爾皮人等日耳曼與薩爾馬提亞部眾；奧斯特羅托塔陣亡後由克尼瓦接掌，251 年他的軍中除哥特人外還有汪達爾人與被羅馬軍隊開除的逃兵。戰局中，菲利波波利斯的羅馬守將提圖斯·尤利烏斯·普里斯庫斯倒戈，與哥特人合作；羅馬與薩珊波斯的邊境戰事同時牽制東線，250 年卡爾皮人又自行進攻達西亞與東西摩西亞，把羅馬的注意力分走。
countriesEn: This war was a frontier conflict in the Balkans between the Roman Empire and a Gothic coalition north of the lower Danube, fought during the Crisis of the Third Century. On the Roman side the framework was the Senate and the Praetorian Guard, while the real military power came from the imperial legions stationed in Upper and Lower Moesia and in Pannonia, from the provincial levies and limitanei of the frontier districts, and from non-citizen auxiliaries in imperial pay. Supreme command rested with the emperor: Philip the Arab until 249, then Decius after his own troops proclaimed him in the spring of that year, then Trebonianus Gallus, raised by the remnant Danubian legions in 251, and finally Aemilianus, governor of Moesia and Pannonia, who directed the campaign on the line in 253. The Gothic side was not a single people but a coalition headed by the Ostrogothic king Ostrogotha, with Argedo and Gunderico each commanding a column; their allies included the Taifals, Bastarnae, Hasdingi and Carpi, Germanic and Sarmatian groups. After Ostrogotha's death the command passed to Cniva, whose host in 251 contained Goths, Vandals, Taifals and deserters from Roman units. In the course of the war the Roman governor of Philippopolis, Titus Julius Priscus, defected and worked with the Goths. Meanwhile Roman fighting with the Sasanian Empire held the eastern front, and a Carpi raid into Dacia and eastern Moesia in 250 pulled Roman attention away from the Danube.
people: 關鍵人物集中在皇帝與王族一端。菲利普斯·阿拉伯人（244 至 249 年在位）是這場戰爭的直接肇因者：他在對薩珊的戰事得手後重整北方邊疆，決定停發自 238 年以來支付給多瑙河北部部落的年貢並廢除其他協議，249 年又在自己禁衛軍發動的政變中被殺。德西烏斯是關鍵的軍事與政治人物，他以元老院議員身分被派往潘諾尼亞與摩西亞主持防務，卻無法約束已瀕臨崩解的邊軍，249 年春反被所部推舉為皇帝，隨即向羅馬進軍企圖廢黜菲利普，留下的權力真空立刻引來更多入侵者。251 年德西烏斯與共治的皇子和繼承人赫倫尼烏斯·埃特魯斯庫斯在阿布里圖斯沼地戰役中一併陣亡。哥特方面的核心人物是東哥特王奧斯特羅托塔與其接任者克尼瓦，前者統率渡河大軍與圍城部隊，後者在 250 至 253 年間主導對摩西亞與色雷斯的攻勢；阿爾格多與貢德里科分兵掠奪摩西亞，菲利波波利斯守將普里斯庫斯倒戈助敵。特雷博尼安努斯·加盧斯以殘存多瑙河軍團的推舉登上皇位，251 年選擇讓克尼瓦帶走戰利品並承諾年貢；接手摩西亞總督的艾米利安努斯在 253 年拒絕兌現承諾，擊退入侵者並追過多瑙河，結束了這場戰爭的戰鬥。史料方面，今日的敘述主要靠 551 年哥爾丹內斯的《論哥特人的起源與事蹟》與六世紀佐西莫斯的《新史》，兩人的數字與細節都須打折閱讀。
peopleEn: The key figures cluster around the emperors and the royal houses. Philip the Arab (r. 244 to 249) is the direct cause of the war: after his successes against the Sasanians he reorganised the northern frontier, decided to stop the annual subsidy paid to the tribes beyond the Danube since 238 and tore up the other agreements, and in 249 he was killed by a coup of his own Praetorian Guard. Decius is the pivotal military and political figure. Sent to Pannonia and Moesia as a senator to take charge of the defence, he could not hold together a frontier army already coming apart; in the spring of 249 his own men acclaimed him emperor, and he marched on Rome to unseat Philip, and the power vacuum that followed immediately drew in more invaders. In 251 Decius and his co-emperor and son Herennius Etruscus were killed together in the marsh battle of Abritus. On the Gothic side the central men were the Ostrogothic king Ostrogotha and his successor Cniva, the first leading the crossing of the river and the sieges, the second directing the campaigns against Moesia and Thrace from 250 to 253; Argedo and Gunderico were sent to strip Moesia, and the governor of Philippopolis, Priscus, defected and aided the enemy. Trebonianus Gallus was raised on the shield by the broken Danubian army and in 251 chose to let Cniva depart with his booty and to promise a yearly tribute. Aemilianus, who took over the government of Moesia, refused to honour that promise in 253, beat back the invasion and pursued the enemy across the Danube, which closed the fighting of the war. Our narrative of these events depends on Jordanes' Getica of 551 and on Zosimus' New History of the sixth century, and both have to be read with a discount on their figures and details.
kits: 卡牌上這件斯巴達長矛是公元前五世紀以來希臘重步兵的標準長矛：兩米左右的木杆，前端裝金屬矛頭，尾端有可以插地支撐的銅套。它在這場戰爭裡並非羅馬軍的制式兵器，卻是理解兩軍兵種差距的鑰匙。三世紀的羅馬帝國步兵以輕型投擲標槍（pilum velitare）與短刺槍（hasta）為主，騎兵配橢圓盾與曲刃刀，輔助軍與邊軍穿鎖子甲或鱗甲，早期的分段甲仍在使用，攻城一方配備配重投石（onager）與弩砲（carroballista）。哥特聯軍的裝備以弓箭為主，步兵用約兩米的中長矛配圓形木盾或小盾，穿皮甲與鎖子甲，騎手用劍與盾，並大量使用從羅馬軍隊繳獲的裝備。真正延續大矛傳統的是色雷斯與巴爾幹地區的長矛兵：拜占庭時期的 skouton，即以長矛配小圓盾的輕裝兵，其形制正是從大矛一系演化而來，並在同一條多瑙河—色雷斯戰線上使用。雙方在攻城與野戰的裝備差距同樣明顯：菲利波波利斯與馬爾齊亞諾波利斯有磚石城牆與塔樓，哥特人只有圍城搬運與破壞用的粗陋手段，羅馬人則有工兵與工程器材，但守軍一旦離開城牆，裝備優勢就會被森林、沼澤與快速騎乘的掠奪隊伍抵消。
kitsEn: The card's dory is the standard spear of the Greek hoplite from the fifth century BC: a wooden shaft about two metres long, an iron head at the front and a bronze butt-spike at the rear. It was not a standard weapon of the Roman army in this war, but it is the key to reading the gap between the two armies' troop types. Third-century Roman infantry fought with the light throwing javelin (pilum velitare) and a short thrusting spear (hasta); cavalry used oval shields and the spatha; auxiliaries and frontier troops wore mail or scale armour, while the older segmented plate was still in use; and the siege train brought the onager and the carroballista. The Gothic coalition fought mainly with the bow, its infantry carrying a medium-length spear of roughly two metres together with a round wooden shield or a small buckler, dressed in leather and mail, while the better equipped men carried sword and shield and made heavy use of arms taken from Roman units. The line that truly carried the dory tradition onward was the long-spear infantry of Thrace and the Balkans: the Byzantine skouton, a lightly equipped skirmisher with long spear and small round shield, descends directly from the dory and served on the very same Danubian-Thracian front. The equipment gap in siege and field was equally stark: Philippopolis and Marcianopolis had brick walls and towers, while the Goths had only rough means of assault and demolition, and the Romans had engineers and works; but once a garrison left its walls, that advantage was cancelled out by forest, marsh and fast mounted raiding bands.
tactics: 哥特聯軍的戰術核心是掠奪、圍城與規避正面決戰。248 年底奧斯特羅托塔渡多瑙河後，讓阿爾格多與貢德里科再入摩西亞，然後直撲設防城市馬爾齊亞諾波利斯，以長期圍困迫使城中出錢贖買，再帶著戰利品退回自己的土地。250 年克尼瓦把大軍分成兩路：兩萬人左右進攻守備空虛的摩西亞並直取菲利波波利斯，他自己率七萬人左右東進至多瑙河畔的歐斯奇亞，把羅馬守軍從縱深拉出；隨後轉向哈伊莫斯山一帶，在菲利波波利斯圍城得逞之後，再與倒戈的守將聯手經營該城。250 至 251 年的冬季，哥特人利用羅馬內部換君造成的空檔奇襲德西烏斯宿營於貝羅埃的軍隊，潰散其全軍，再合兵於阿布里圖斯打出一場決定性的戰鬥；羅軍在沼澤中行軍受阻，前後隊脫節，陣形與指揮在泥濘中崩解，皇帝與其子相繼陣亡。羅馬方面的戰術意圖則是集中兵力、皇帝親征、修補多瑙河要塞再尋機反擊，但野戰軍被拉去對付奪位者之後，邊境只剩守備薄弱的邊軍。253 年艾米利安努斯改採主動出擊：在擊退越過多瑙河的哥特聯軍後，以一次快速渡河追擊直抵其營地，繳回大批戰利品並贖回被擄走的羅馬公民，使多瑙河前線安靜下來數年。
tacticsEn: The tactical core of the Gothic coalition was plunder, siege and the avoidance of pitched battle. After Ostrogotha crossed the Danube at the end of 248 he sent Argedo and Gunderico back into Moesia and then moved against the fortified city of Marcianopolis, where a long blockade forced the city to pay for the attacks to stop, after which he withdrew to his own country with his spoil. In 250 Cniva split his host in two: some 20,000 men were sent against the thinly held Moesia and on to Philippopolis, while he himself led about 70,000 east to Euscia on the Danube, pulling the Roman garrison out of the interior; he then turned towards Mount Haemus, took Philippopolis after a long siege, and joined hands with the defected governor to work the city. In the winter of 250 to 251 the Goths exploited the confusion caused by the change of emperor to surprise Decius's army camped at Beroe and destroy it, then concentrated for the decisive action at Abritus, where the Roman column was checked in the marsh, the ranks came apart in the mud and the command dissolved, and the emperor and his son fell in turn. The Roman intention was concentration of force, the personal command of the emperor, and repair of the Danubian fortresses followed by a counterstroke, but once the field army was drawn off to settle the succession, the frontier held only thinly garrisoned limitanei. In 253 Aemilianus switched to the offensive: after beating back the Goths who had crossed the Danube, he launched a rapid pursuit across the river against their camp, recovering much booty and ransoming Roman citizens carried off, and the Danubian front stayed quiet for some years afterwards.
data: 可用的數字不多，且多數出自晚期史家，須打折看待。喬爾丹內斯稱奧斯特羅托塔渡河的聯軍有三十萬人，但拜占庭作家慣於把敵軍數字放大十倍，同一作者記載的六萬阿勒曼尼人戰死與當代阿米亞努斯所記的六千之差即為例證，因此比較合理的估值是三萬上下。克尼瓦分兵的比例則有明確記載：一路約兩萬人攻略摩西亞與菲利波波利斯，他自己率約七萬人取歐斯奇亞，兩處目標在多瑙河東岸相距約二百五十公里。戰役年份可排成序列：248 年底奧斯特羅托塔渡河與馬爾齊亞諾波利斯圍城；249 年德西烏斯被推舉為帝；250 年卡爾皮人入侵達西亞、克尼瓦再攻摩西亞與菲利波波利斯，該城在長期圍困後於夏季陷落；251 年阿布里圖斯之戰、皇帝陣亡、加盧斯即位並許諾年貢；253 年新一輪入侵被艾米利安努斯擊退。同期背景數字是西普里安瘟疫，251 至 270 年間造成帝國約百分之十五至百分之三十的人口死亡，軍隊與邊區的承受力隨之下降。戰鬥之後，多瑙河前線安靜數年，256 與 257 年卡爾皮聯盟再入摩西亞、洗劫色雷斯並圍攻帖撒羅尼基，267 或 268 年哥特人深入至愛琴海岸，268 至 269 年在納伊蘇斯才被擋下。
dataEn: The usable figures are few, and most come from late historians, so they have to be discounted. Jordanes gives 300,000 men for the coalition Ostrogotha led across the Danube, but Byzantine writers habitually multiply enemy numbers by ten - the same author's 60,000 Alemanni dead against the 6,000 recorded by the contemporary Ammianus Marcellinus shows the pattern - so a figure around 30,000 is the more reasonable reading. The proportions of Cniva's split are more explicit: about 20,000 men were sent against Moesia and Philippopolis while he took about 70,000 to Euscia, and the two objectives lie some 250 kilometres apart along the eastern bank of the Danube. The chronology can be fixed: the crossing of Ostrogotha and the siege of Marcianopolis at the end of 248; the acclamation of Decius in 249; the Carpi invasion of Dacia, the renewed Goth attack on Moesia and Philippopolis and the fall of that city after a long siege in the summer of 250; the battle of Abritus with the death of the emperor, the accession of Gallus and the promise of tribute in 251; and the repulse of a fresh invasion in 253. The background figure is the plague of Cyprian, which between 251 and 270 killed roughly 15 to 30 per cent of the imperial population, with the army and the frontier districts hit accordingly. After the fighting the Danube stayed quiet for some years; the Carpi-led coalition returned to Moesia in 256 and 257 to sack Thrace and besiege Thessalonica, and Goths reached the Aegean coast in 267 or 268 before being stopped at Naissus in 268 to 269.
cause: 打起來的原因有兩條線。一條是羅馬的邊疆政策：從塞維魯斯·亞歷山大在位時起，帝國不斷把新村落遷到多瑙河畔，把原本游牧在外的部落擠進邊境地帶；238 年春，這些被希臘與拉丁作家籠統稱為西徐亞人的戰士越過卡爾皮與達西亞的地盤進入下摩西亞，攻掠了奧爾比亞與提拉斯的舊希臘殖民地，也洗劫了河口城市伊斯特羅斯。帝國用年貢買平安的傳統做法，在菲利普斯·阿拉伯人手中被廢止，他自認對薩珊的勝利已足以收回這些讓步，於是同時取消其他協議。另一條線是帝國自身的崩解：皇位在 249 年被禁衛軍一場政變換掉，野戰軍被拉去羅馬搞權位鬥爭，多瑙河防線只剩缺員的邊軍，德西烏斯的部隊甚至集體倒向哥特人請求保護。251 年起席捲帝國的瘟疫又抽走兵源與稅基，使任何一個皇帝都難以同時守住防線與對付北方。於是原本可以用錢擺平的邊境衝突，變成雙方都要以戰爭見真章的全面碰撞。
causeEn: There are two threads to the outbreak. The first is Roman frontier policy: from the reign of Severus Alexander the empire had repeatedly moved new settlements up to the Danube, pushing peoples who had lived outside the frontier into the border zone; in the spring of 238 warriors generically called Scythians by the Greek and Latin writers crossed the lands of the Carpi and Dacia into Lower Moesia, stripped the old Greek colonies of Olbia and Tiras and sacked the river town of Istros. The old Roman habit of buying peace with money ended under Philip the Arab, who, confident after his victories over the Sasanians, decided to stop the annual subsidy and cancel the other agreements. The second thread is the empire's own disintegration: the throne changed hands in 249 after a coup by the Praetorian Guard, the field army was dragged off to Rome to settle the succession, the Danube was left to under-manned limitanei, and even Decius's own troops went over to the Goths and asked for their protection. From 251 the plague sweeping the empire drained manpower and tax revenue, so that no emperor could hold the line and face the north at the same time. What had been a frontier quarrel that money could settle turned into a collision in which both sides had to test the issue in battle.
impact: 這場戰爭的直接後果，是羅馬的多瑙河防線體系被徹底壓垮。野戰軍與邊軍分離，皇帝不再能靠駐防軍團守邊，必須把精銳調去應付內鬥，德西烏斯甚至在即位後率軍直指羅馬，結果是邊境在最有利的時刻陷入真空。251 年的停戰條件是一筆年貢加一次掠奪的既成事實，等於承認羅馬無法獨力阻止哥特聯軍進入摩西亞；而 253 年艾米利安努斯的反擊雖然在戰術上漂亮，卻沒有改變帝國的結構性弱點。帝國從此把邊防的主動權交給軍事強人，這條路在 260 年代通向加利埃努斯與戴克里先：戴克里先的軍隊與行省重組、稅制改革、擱置元老院的舊式執政安排，以及把邊防承包給日耳曼同盟者的作法，都可以在 249 年之後的連串挫敗裡找到源頭。更長遠看，哥特人此後被大量吸收為帝國的僱傭兵與同盟者，既是可用的兵源，也是下一次崩潰時的內憂。北方部落在 256、257 年洗劫色雷斯並圍攻帖撒羅尼基，267 或 268 年更深入至愛琴海，直到納伊蘇斯才被擋下；而在多瑙河另一邊，匈奴西遷的壓力正在累積。四百年後查士丁尼再對東哥特開戰時，爭奪的仍是同一條防線、同一批城市、同一條多瑙河。
impactEn: The direct consequence of this war was the collapse of the Roman Danubian defence system. Field army and frontier troops came apart, emperors could no longer rely on garrisoned legions to hold the line and had to drag the best troops away to fight over the throne - Decius himself marched on Rome right after his accession - and the frontier went empty at the moment most favourable to an enemy. The terms of 251 amounted to a yearly subsidy plus a fait accompli of plunder, an admission that Rome could not by itself keep the Gothic coalition out of Moesia; Aemilianus's counterstroke in 253 was tactically handsome but changed none of the structural weakness. From then on the empire handed the initiative on the frontier to strong military men, and that road in the 260s leads to Gallienus and Diocletian: the reorganization of the army and the provinces, the reform of taxation, the shelving of the old senatorial style of government and the practice of hiring the defence out to Germanic allies all have their origin in the run of defeats that began in 249. In the longer term the Goths were absorbed in large numbers as mercenaries and federate troops of the empire - useful soldiers, but also a source of the next collapse. The northern tribes sacked Thrace and besieged Thessalonica in 256 and 257 and reached the Aegean in 267 or 268 before being stopped at Naissus, while on the far side of the Danube the pressure of the Hunnic migration was building. Four centuries later, when Justinian went to war against the Ostrogoths, the objects contested were the same frontier, the same cities and the same river.
result: 戰爭打到 253 年才停，結局並不光彩地分成兩截。248 至 249 年，奧斯特羅托塔的渡河大軍在邊軍缺員的窗口裡連下摩西亞與色雷斯，圍困設防城市馬爾齊亞諾波利斯，榨出贖金後帶財而還，羅馬沒有組織起任何有效反擊；251 年，德西烏斯父子在阿布里圖斯沼地戰役中陣亡，羅馬史上最慘重的野戰失敗之一就這樣發生在他們手裡，多瑙河防線連同潘諾尼亞與摩西亞的野戰軍一起崩解。251 年加盧斯以殘軍即位後選擇認輸，允許克尼瓦帶走戰利品，並承諾每年付貢，這是羅馬第一次以錢換取退兵。253 年，艾米利安努斯拒絕兌現這筆承諾，哥特聯軍再入摩西亞與色雷斯，他把他們擊退並以快速渡河追擊到多瑙河北岸，繳回大批戰利品，贖回被擄的羅馬公民，多瑙河前線因此安靜了數年。從結果看，哥特聯軍沒有取得永久的立足點，羅馬也沒有恢復主動權；這場戰爭的直接成果是帝國承認了北方邊境必須靠歲幣與軍事強人撐住，而真正的解決要等到兩個半世紀後戴克里先的改革與四世紀末的形勢逆轉。戰場上唯一留下確切痕跡的物證，是阿普隆出土的祭壇，上面刻著獲釋者對卡爾皮人的感謝，說明戰亂中俘虜的命運一直延續到戰後很久。
resultEn: The war dragged on until 253 and its outcome divides into two discreditable halves. In 248 and 249 Ostrogotha's host crossed the river in the window opened by the under-manned frontier, took Lower Moesia and Thrace, blockaded the fortified city of Marcianopolis and extorted a ransom before carrying its plunder home; Rome managed no effective counterstroke at all. In 251 Decius and his son fell in the marsh battle of Abritus, one of the worst field defeats in Roman history, and the Danubian line collapsed together with the field armies of Pannonia and Moesia. Gallus, raised on the shield by the broken army, chose to concede: he let Cniva depart with his booty and promised a yearly tribute, the first time Rome had bought a withdrawal with money. In 253 Aemilianus refused to honour that promise; the Goths came back into Moesia and Thrace, he beat them back and carried the pursuit across the Danube in a rapid stroke, recovering much booty and ransoming Roman captives, and the Danubian front stayed quiet for some years. In result the Gothic coalition gained no permanent foothold and Rome recovered no initiative; what the war delivered was the empire's admission that the northern frontier had to be held with coin and with strong military men, and the real settlement had to wait for Diocletian's reforms two and a half centuries later and for the reversal of the situation at the end of the fourth century. The only material trace left on the battlefield is the altar found at Apulum, dedicated by a freedman in gratitude to those who ransomed him from the Carpi, which shows that the fate of prisoners of war continued well past the fighting.
